relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber and Information Security Agency (NÚKIB) & Government of the Czech Republic (nukib.gov.cz) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for National Cyber and Information Security Agency (NÚKIB) & Government of the Czech Republic (nukib.gov.cz).
